role: Recording Media R&D Intern, AI & Data Science
jd:
About Our Group

You will join the HAMR Media Mechanical R&D group at Seagate’s Recording Media Research Center in Fremont, CA, where we develop advanced media interfaces, coating technologies, characterization methods, reliability testing capabilities, and AI/ML solutions for HAMR magnetic recording media. Our team collaborates closely with sputter process, recording physics, equipment engineering, materials science lab, drive design and recording head design teams, and manufacturing teams across Seagate’s global organization. Together, we develop next-generation, high-capacity storage technologies for AI, cloud computing, edge computing, and other emerging applications.

About The Role - You Will

You will work closely with R&D engineers to apply data science, machine learning, and generative AI to magnetic recording media R&D. You will contribute to one or more projects that improve understanding of media performance and failure mechanisms, make technical knowledge easier to access, and improve R&D efficiency.

Responsibilities Include



- Develop reusable data analysis workflows and interactive dashboards that integrate design, process, manufacturing, and reliability data to identify performance drivers and support engineering decisions. 
- Work with domain experts to develop and evaluate predictive models for media performance and reliability, with attention to data quality, appropriate validation, and interpretation of results. 
- Prototype and evaluate GenAI applications, such as technical knowledge bases and agentic workflows, to support knowledge retrieval, research synthesis, and engineering analysis. 

What You Will Gain



- Hands-on experience applying AI and data science to design, process, and reliability challenges in advanced HAMR media development. 
- Opportunities to collaborate with cross-functional R&D teams and translate analytical insights into practical design and process improvements. 
- Mentoring from the R&D AI Business Lead and engineers, with opportunities to present your work to world-class recording media experts. 

About You



- Strong problem-solving and communication skills, curiosity about unfamiliar scientific domains, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively. 
- Commitment to responsible handling of confidential technical information. 

Your Experience Includes



- Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of SQL, with experience cleaning, integrating, analyzing, and visualizing data. 
- A solid foundation in statistics and machine learning, including exploratory analysis, feature engineering, model evaluation, and interpretation. 
- Hands-on experience through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects in machine learning, data analytics, or GenAI application development. 
- Familiarity with relevant tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, and data visualization libraries.
- Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, statistics, applied mathematics, computer or electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

You May Also Have



- Experience building GenAI applications using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, or tool-using agents. 
- Experience processing technical documents, including extracting and organizing information from reports, presentations, tables, and figures. 
- Experience adapting and evaluating open-source language models using tools such as Hugging Face and PyTorch, or parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA. 
- Familiarity with experimental design, uncertainty estimation, interpretable ML, or analysis of scientific and engineering datasets. 
- Experience with Git, reusable data pipelines, application development, or tools such as Power BI, Hadoop, or Snowflake. 
- Familiarity with enterprise data access controls and secure use of AI tools. 

Location:

Our Gold LEED-certified Fremont product-design campus drives innovation, bringing together a diverse set of engineering, design, operations, support, and administrative teams. The site is equipped with a state-of-the-art clean room and lab space. On-site social activities are popular, including our annual BBQ, ice cream social, and holiday events. Wellness programs, gaming rooms, and the on-site fitness center help round out and balance your Seagate work-life experience, along with opportunities to give back to our local community.

The estimated base wage range for this position is $26 - $41/hr. The individual base wage is based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Seagate offers comprehensive benefits to its eligible Interns, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, and participation in the employee stock purchase plan. Seagate also offers Interns 12 paid holidays and a minimum of 48 hours of paid sick leave. The benefits for this position are based on a 24 to 40-hour-per-week schedule for a full calendar year and may differ depending on work location and tenure with the Company.

Location: Fremont USA Research Center

Travel: None
fit_why: Python/pandas/SQL data work, but materials-science domain and ML depth

Come make your difference in communities across Canada, where authenticity, trust and making connections is valued – as we shape the future of Canadian retail, together. Our unique position as one of the country's largest employers, coupled with our commitment to positively impact the lives of all Canadians, provides our colleagues a range of opportunities and experiences to help Canadians Live Life Well®.

At Loblaw Companies Limited, we succeed through collaboration and commitment and set a high bar for ourselves and those around us. Whether you are just starting your career, re-entering the workforce, or looking for a new job, this is where you belong.

Winter 2027 Work Term

Term Length: 4 months

Term Start: January 6, 2027

Term End: April 16, 2027

The pay range for the co-op student role will reflect factors such as the candidate's experience, academic level, and the specific skillset required for the role.

Loblaw has adopted the following hybrid working model (a combination of working between the office and remotely). Colleagues can work remotely up to 1 day a week, while spending the other 4 days in the office (to be determined by each business unit).

About Loblaws

At Loblaw, we help millions of Canadians get through their best days, worst days, celebration days, and every day. Through our innovation and quality products, we’re here for our friends, neighbours, family members and colleagues.

Come make your difference in communities across Canada, where authenticity, trust and making connections is valued – as we shape the future of Canadian retail, together. Our unique position as one of the country's largest employers, coupled with our commitment to positively impact the lives of all Canadians, provides our colleagues a range of opportunities and experiences to help Canadians Live Life Well®.

Position Overview

Join our Applied Machine Learning team and help solve real operational challenges across one of Canada's largest supply chains. Although our team is called Applied Machine Learning, our day-to-day work focuses primarily on software development, data engineering, and process automation. We build Python applications, SQL solutions, dashboards, and internal tools that save hundreds of hours of manual work and improve supply chain operations. Machine learning is occasionally part of our toolkit, but it is not the primary focus of this role.

You May Work On Projects Such As



- Building Python applications that automate manual business processes
- Writing SQL against enterprise data warehouses (BigQuery and Oracle)
- Developing internal dashboards and reporting tools
- Integrating systems using APIs
- Designing workflows that eliminate repetitive operational tasks
- Working directly with business partners to understand problems and deliver practical solutions
- Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and operational applications.
- Developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Windows virtual machine environments.

You'll own real projects from concept to production—not just small pieces of larger initiatives. From gathering business requirements through design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support, you'll experience the full software development lifecycle while receiving mentorship from the team.

Responsibilities



- Develop Python applications that automate supply chain processes.
- Write efficient SQL queries against enterprise-scale datasets in BigQuery and Oracle.
- Design, build, test, and deploy internal tools used by Supply Chain teams across Canada.
- Partner directly with business users to understand operational challenges and translate them into technical solutions.
- Investigate production issues, troubleshoot problems, and continuously improve existing automation.
- Create clear technical documentation to ensure solutions are maintainable and easy to support.
- Continuously identify opportunities to eliminate manual work through automation.

Technologies You'll Use



- Python
- SQL (Google BigQuery & Oracle)
- Google Cloud Platform
- Jupyter Notebooks
- Power BI
- Git
- Jira
- Confluence
- Windows and Linux development environments

What You’ll Need



- Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience writing Python applications and SQL queries. Exposure to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (preferred), AWS, or Azure is an asset.
- Strong curiosity and a willingness to independently learn new technologies.
- Resourceful and comfortable researching unfamiliar problems independently while knowing when to seek guidance.
- Enjoys solving ambiguous business problems with practical software solutions.
- Able to work independently while communicating progress and asking thoughtful questions when needed.
- Strong attention to detail and a desire to build reliable, maintainable software.

Please note Loblaw's Return to Office policy is 4 days in the office.

Nuovo Artistic Studios is the premier destination for all things self-love. A by-women company and one of the largest artistic photography companies in North America, Nuovo is on a mission to empower individuals by fostering confidence and self-expression while celebrating intimacy and individuality.

We're looking for a Software Developer Intern to join our team. This role is ideal for a student who is eager to grow their development skills, gain hands-on experience building real-world products and explore how AI is transforming the way software is developed. You'll contribute to internal applications, collaborate on ongoing product development and learn how to build, test, and maintain software in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. We're looking for someone who is curious, proactive and excited about building products.

This Internship will take place from January 11th to April 30th, 2027

What You'll Do:



- Contribute to small features, UI improvements and bug fixes across our internal applications
- Support our team on ongoing product development, feature requests and development tickets
- Write and maintain clear technical documentation to support our applications and development processes
- Test new features, perform quality assurance and help ensure applications are reliable before releases
- Participate in code reviews and collaborate on implementing clean, maintainable code 
- Join product planning discussions and contribute ideas to improve our tools, workflows and user experience 
- Explore AI-powered coding tools and emerging development practices to help improve productivity and the way we build software 

Requirements

About You:



- Currently pursuing a diploma or degree in Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, with plans to return to school following the Internship 
- Comfortable with full-stack development, including Python and web development across front-end and back-end environments
- Familiar with Git and fundamental development practices, including code reviews, testing and documentation
- Curious about UI/UX design and creating intuitive, user-friendly experiences; experience in this area is an asset
- Up to date on AI coding tools and interested in how AI is changing software development
- Interested in product development and understanding how software solves real-world problems
- A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with others, adaptable and eager to learn 
- Fluent in English and French is considered a strong asset 

Benefits

What We Offer:



- Inspiring Work Environment: Immerse yourself in a creative, collaborative company where artistry and empowerment converge
- Growth Opportunities: Be part of a fast-growing company committed to nurturing talent and fostering career development
- Recognition and Support: A team that values your contributions and celebrates your success
- Exclusive Perks: Access to Nuovo's services and products, ensuring you, too, can experience the power of portraiture. We also provide you with a 50% Family & Friends discount

About Us:

Nuovo Artistic Studios is not just a photography studio; it's a movement designed to uplift, empower, and transform. Our mission is to provide every guest with a luxury experience that inspires confidence and celebrates individuality. With studios across North America, we are redefining the art of modern portraiture, one empowered story at a time.

This is your opportunity to join a team dedicated to excellence and artistry. Become part of the Nuovo legacy and make an impact, one unforgettable moment at a time.

This is your moment. Apply today!
fit_why: Full-stack internal apps match; photography company, UI/Python fit

Availability for the entire program duration is required to successfully participate in the Summer 2027 term (16 months).

As a co-op/intern student at BMO, you will have the opportunity to be heard, keep growing and make a difference.

You will be part of our campus program to gain the skills and knowledge needed to take on roles similar to the description listed below.

Our student experience is designed to integrate you to the BMO team from day one by adding value in the work you do. Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build a lasting business including: paid memberships, free memberships, community chats, live video, and selling to fans directly with one-time purchases.

Ultimately our goal is simple: fund the creative class. And we're leaders in that space, with:

 - $10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon's inception

 - 100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet, and

 - 25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today.
   
   

We're continuing to invest in building the best creator platform with the best team in the creator economy and are looking for Software Engineering Interns to support our mission.



This role is based in San Francisco or New York and open to those who are able to be in-office 3 days per week on a hybrid work model.



Our summer internship is a 12-week program running May–August or June–September 2027. This internship is designed for students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028.





ABOUT THE ROLE

What you will do:

 - Make an impact. You’ll build and ship a feature that directly supports the creator economy and helps your favorite creators turn their passions into sustainable careers.

 - Collaborate with the best. You’ll be embedded within a world-class engineering team, working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists to bring your project to life.

 - Learn and grow. With guidance from an experienced engineer mentor, you’ll tackle technical challenges, gain hands-on experience, and grow your skills throughout the internship.

 - Have fun! Beyond building great products, you’ll participate in team activities and events.



ABOUT YOU

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (i.e. Mathematics, Physics).

 - Strong foundation in Computer Science fundamentals and data structures.

 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, Swift, Kotlin, or TypeScript.

 - Eagerness to learn, adapt, and grow through feedback.

 - Genuine passion for Patreon’s mission and supporting the creator economy.



ABOUT PATREON

Patreon powers creators to do what they love and get paid by the people who love what they do. Our team is passionate about making this mission and our core values come to life every day in our work. Through this work, our Patronauts:

 - Put Creators First | They’re the reason we’re here. When creators win, we win.

 - Build with Craft | We sign our name to every deliverable, just like the creators we serve.

 - Make it Happen | We don’t quit. We learn and deliver.

 - Win Together | We grow as individuals. We win as a team.

We hire talented and passionate people from different backgrounds because workplace diversity and inclusion is critical to our ability to serve creators worldwide. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t match with every bullet point outlined above, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. If you’re a creator at heart, are energized by our mission, and share our company values, we’d love to hear from you.

Patreon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, please let us know via email at accomodations@patreon.com.

Patreon operates under a hybrid work model, where engineering interns are expected to come into the office three days per week, excluding sick time and leave. The goal of this policy is to be intentional about the in-person time we spend together to strengthen the feeling of community at Patreon.

At Patreon, we believe in fair and transparent pay. In compliance with New York and California pay transparency laws, we are sharing the expected salary range for this role.

The posted salary range is dependent on the location and the level. This range may encompass multiple levels within the role’s job family. The final offer will be based on candidate’s experience, skills, competencies, and geographic location, aligning with the appropriate job level within Patreon’s leveling framework.

Patreon reserves the right to modify or update compensation and benefits at any time.
fit_why: Full-stack SWE intern, web stack match; degree-level and location ignored

 We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

 To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

 Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

 If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 You'll work with a team of skilled engineers and a dedicated mentor on real-world, production oriented product features on a wide range of sophisticated problems in everything from API and web design to systems engineering and data infrastructure.

 Main responsibilities:

• Collaborate with team members to coordinate and drive projects forward 

• Work on individual and group projects focused on the full project lifecycle 

• Team up with business leaders and key stakeholders to accomplish project objectives 

• Use a broad spectrum of technologies and programming languages 

• Access technology/engineering leadership who want to hear your ideas 

• Leverage the latest AI tools to accelerate learning, discovery and delivery in our production codebase 
 
 WHO YOU ARE 

 Requirements:

• Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, or equivalent with one or less academic year remaining after your Braze internship 

• Available for a 10 week internship between June and August 

• Intellectually curious, passionate, and inventive 

• Detail-oriented, curious, and strong with communication 

• Attentive to detail, strong communication, and a curious thinker 

• Able to work in-person at our NYC office 
 
 You can expect:

• Competitive compensation 

• Intern events including executive lunch, team events, and end of program presentations 

• Full-time return offers subject to performance 

• Collaborative, transparent, and fun loving team and office culture 
 
 For candidates based in the United States, the pay for this position at the start of employment is expected to be $60/hour.

 #LI-Onsite
 WHAT WE OFFER 

 Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment. 

 From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

• Competitive compensation that may include equity 

• Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans 

• Flexible paid time off 

• Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability 

• Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave 

• Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend 

• A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation 

• Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching 

• Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze 

• Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® 
 
 ABOUT BRAZE 

 Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

 The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

 Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

 The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

 BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER 

 At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

 Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

 We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

 OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS 

 At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

 This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

 Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

• To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. 

• To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com .  
 
 Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page .

 Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144) 

 Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review. 

 To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application.
